verdict.rationale: Pipecat Cloud has a documented REST API that manages agents, including POST /agents to create an agent, and an API that starts agent sessions. The official CLI also offers a cloud deploy command, so the agent-creation step can be done without the dashboard. Telephony, however, works by the carrier (Twilio, Telnyx, etc.) calling the user's webhook, and no Pipecat API, CLI, or MCP path is documented for buying or attaching a phone number or placing an outbound PSTN call. The MCP server (context-hub) is a docs index, not a provisioning tool. missing for 10: programmatic phone-number provisioning/attachment, a documented outbound call-placement API, MCP-based provisioning tools, hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end headless flow

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can provision a complete voice agent end to end — create the agent, attach a number, and place a call — through the API, CLI, or MCP without touching the dashboard
